rationale: The R7 defect JOB 1 measured on the full corpus, pinned on the smallest input that reproduces every part of it. `def this(name: String, retries: Int) = this(name)` is an AUXILIARY CONSTRUCTOR; the pinned grammar fills the node's `name:` field with the keyword, so before the fix the analyzer published a method symbol named `this` and then published 1,336 endpoints across 209 files that named a member no file declares: `contains Service -> this`, `calls this -> this`, `instantiates this -> <arg type>`, and every declared-type reference inside the auxiliary's parameter list sourced at `this`. The fix models the construct as what it IS — a constructor of the class, which already owns a `constructor` symbol — so there is no new symbol, the parameters fold into that payload, the body's edges source at `Service` (a real symbol), and `this(...)` publishes no call edge at all because constructor DELEGATION is not a call to a member named `this`. The second half is class C of the same census: a KEYWORD LITERAL interpolated (`s"$null"`) parses as interpolation > identifier, identically to `s"$name"`, so a read emitter that does not ask whether the child is a reference publishes `uses Probe -> null` for a constant. Measured 7 endpoints, all in scala3 test/files/neg/t5856.scala. The `${...}` block form is pinned as the positive control: it is an expression, not an identifier, and it has never emitted — so its ABSENCE is what makes the two rows above a defect of the `$name` form specifically rather than of interpolation handling in general.

expectRelationships.note: the ordinary member, the positive control for the contains row below
the class owns exactly ONE constructor symbol; the auxiliary folds into it rather than publishing a second

forbidRelationships.note: R7: no file declares a member called `this`. This is the exact shape of the defect — 648 target endpoints over 209 corpus files.
`this(...)` is constructor DELEGATION, not a call to a member (648 of the corpus rows were sources, 136 targets)
and it is never a SOURCE either — the auxiliary's body belongs to the class
the parameter types the auxiliary declares are referenced by the CLASS (688 source endpoints on the corpus)
R7 class C: `null` is a constant, not a declaration

the `${...}` block form is an EXPRESSION and this lane emits no expression-level use for it (D1/D3); pinning it as forbidden makes the two keyword rows above attributable to the `$name` form specifically
